Name: Lovely Kitchen (CP)
Author: lululovely
Description:
Add a lovely new kitchen with colorful retro appliances, a stand mixer, cookbooks, mix and match cabinets and counters, and a cake (that's no lie)!

[i]- Replaces the default farmhouse, cabin, and island house kitchens. Also includes a white wall tile option and a cuter coffee maker.[/i]

- ﻿You can also add [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541]Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras[/url][/b] for more coordinating kitchen furniture!

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =
[b]
* * *   INSTRUCTIONS   * * *
[/b]
- Install the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Download this mod, unzip it, and place the '[CP]Lovely Kitchen Replacement' folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
- Run the game once and quit to generate a config.json file.
- Edit the config.json file with the configuration options listed below to customize your kitchens!

= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =
[b]
* * *   CONFIGURATION OPTIONS   * * *
[/b]
More detailed instructions are included in readme.txt, plus a folder of reference images.

[b]Colors for the farmhouse, cabins, and island kitchens can each be chosen separately![/b]


Farmhouse, Cabin, and Island Cabinets
Changes the color of the cabinets.- choose one - gray, pink, mint, green, sky, blue, birch, walnut, oak, white, cream, black, yellow, red, lilac, purple, navy, orange

Farmhouse, Cabin, and Island Appliances
Changes the stove and fridge color in the farmhouse, cabins, and island house.
- choose one - cream, mint, pink, sky, stainless, white, copper, black


Farmhouse and Cabin Counters
This changes three things. Light, medium, or dark counter. The letter in the middle changes the tile backsplash to light "a" or dark "b". The color choices affect the stand mixer and cookbook.
- choose one - light_a_blue, light_a_green, light_a_neutral, light_a_pink, light_a_red,
light_b_blue, light_b_green, light_b_neutral, light_b_pink, light_b_red,
medium_a_blue, medium_a_green, medium_a_neutral, medium_a_pink, medium_a_red,
medium_b_blue, medium_b_green, medium_b_neutral, medium_b_pink, medium_b_red,
dark_a_blue, dark_a_green, dark_a_neutral, dark_a_pink, dark_a_red,
dark_b_blue, dark_b_green, dark_b_neutral, dark_b_pink, dark_b_red


Island Counters
There's just a little bit visible by the sink.
- choose one - light, dark


Farmhouse, Cabin, and Island Handles
Changes the cabinet knobs, appliance handles, and sink faucet.
- choose one - black, brass, bronze, gold, nickel, red, blue, silver


Mini Fridge
"﻿True" matches the mini fridge to your farmhouse appliances color, "false" leaves it vanilla.
- choose one - true, false


Wall Tile
﻿The darker "b" backsplash above the farmhouse and cabin counters matches an existing gray tile wallpaper in the game. "True" will override that wallpaper to match the lighter "a" backsplash, and "false" keeps it vanilla. (May not work with other wall and flooring replacement mods.)
- choose one - true, false


Coffee Maker
"True" changes the coffee maker to a much cuter option on a little wooden cart, "false" keeps it vanilla.
- choose one - true, false


﻿= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =

There's a cute new coffee maker included in Lovely Kitchen! And [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8314]Lovely Coffee Maker[/url]﻿ is also available separately to use without Lovely Kitchen.

Version 1.2
6 new cabinet colors and black appliances! I've also made another coordinating mod: [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541]Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras[/url][/b]. You can add matching kitchen islands and freestanding kitchen cabinets! The Coffee Maker and Telephone will look like part of the kitchen too. Works with Alternative Textures.
